Driftwood Cove Cottage with Garden Hot Tub

About this space
A cedar-shingled cottage two streets from the water in the village of Driftwood Cove. Wake up to gulls, walk to the harbor for breakfast, and end the day in the hot tub under the stars.

The space
The cottage has two bedrooms upstairs: one with a queen bed and one with two twin beds. Downstairs there is an open living room with a wood stove, a dining table for six, and a full kitchen. A sofa bed in the den sleeps two more.

Guest access
Guests have the whole cottage and the fenced garden to themselves. There is parking for two cars in the driveway.

Other things to note
The stairs are steep, so the cottage may not suit small children.

What this place offers
Hot tub
Kitchen
Wifi
Free parking on premises
Washer
Wood stove
Fenced garden

House rules
Check-in after 3:00 PM
Checkout before 11:00 AM
6 guests maximum
No parties or events
No smoking
Pets allowed
